journey.name: wear tile balance
journey.description:
The Bitkit tile shows the balance the app loaded and a Receive edge button that opens the app on the receive QR. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet, its balance loaded on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped. README › Tiles has the commands that add and show a tile. Tiles are drawn by the system, so `android layout` does not list their content: check them from a screenshot. The tile without a wallet (the Bitkit mark and "Restore") and with a balance not loaded yet (the dimmed mark) are covered by `TileStateTest.kt` and the PR's screenshots.

actions.action: Add the tile as in README › Tiles
Show the tile as in README › Tiles and wait 3 s
Verify from a screenshot that the tile shows "₿ <balance>" and an orange QR edge button below it
Tap the QR edge button at the point the screenshot shows
Wait up to 10 s until `adb shell uiautomator dump` lists "WatchReceiveQr" (README, top)
Swipe to dismiss from the left edge: `adb shell input swipe 20 227 400 227 300`
Verify the Balance page: "WatchHomeBalance" is listed
Remove the tile as in README › Tiles
